title: Ask HN: Got any interesting tech incident to share?
excerpt: Not a real “incident” but quite founny: After exactly 49 days, 17 hours, 2 minutes, and 47 seconds of continuous operation a MacMini loses its network connection. We have several MacMini OCR-Clients that always stopped working after about 50 days. Was quite funny as we found out the “bug” that can only fixed with a restart.
